outcomes: Pinned Claude subscription requests one Bash job over the private MCP transport. Built-in native tools remain disabled.
The actual network-none/seccomp worker edits calculator.py and creates notes/build.txt with no host credentials or Git metadata.
Current policy, owner/project, contract, lease/epoch and one-use invocation are checked before Docker create/start and receipt publication.
Stopped worker bytes become protected Git objects with no worker Git/config/hooks/filters; no protected ref changes during capture.
A separate read-only verifier checks the frozen tree and path/policy clauses; worker self-declared pass does not establish acceptance.
Exact scripted test-owner approval is required for protected Git CAS. Wrong digest and redispatch are rejected.
SessionStart, PreToolUse, repository MCP and hostile CLAUDE.md remain inert in the actual native launch.
limits: V1 is one bounded command per durable job, up to 30s and 8KiB output; output stays in protected evidence and MCP returns metadata only.
PUBLIC synthetic native conformance uses explicit operator authorization; local edit authority does not authorize cloud context export.
Generic owner-project cloud admission/context selection and runtime certificate wiring still require a controller integration. No arbitrary project launch endpoint is exposed.
Scripted disposable test-owner approval is not human acceptance. No unqualified G1/G3 release pass.
AOS-016-TC04 is owner-deferred; existing subscription/local-only and no provider fallback restrictions remain.
The first live run failed closed on the new server display label; its raw evidence is preserved. The correction binds that label only to the separately enabled Bash profile.
